searchText: **Glamsterdam Meta EIP-7773 to EIP-7610 (Revert creation in case of non-empty storage) is still really annoying EIP and it breaks with BAL, was EIP that clears empty account with storage PFI-ed for hegota (So that we can fully remove EIP-7610)? **ACDE <t:1786629600:R>** Agenda: <https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/2178> Stream: <https://youtube.com/watch?v=ekpA2ZA2GJw> Zoom: <https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/85451723466?pwd=RgAVD0sO4OPFAU3UIqPflda1z05cRT.1> Is there a test case demonstrating that EIP-7610 breaks under BAL? If not there needs to be before we consider removing the existing 7610 test cases. ACDE 243
